summary: On or about April 8, 2026 Solari Accountancy, a tax and accounting firm in Lodi, California, found that an unauthorized person had gained access to its tax software system. The firm said client tax returns were not directly affected but could not rule out exposure of client personal information. It secured the system, brought in cybersecurity professionals and notified law enforcement, the IRS and the California Franchise Tax Board.
